## Summary

Describe the change and the user problem it solves.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `python -m compileall -q app scripts migrations`
- [ ] `node --check app/static/app.js`
- [ ] Clean database migration tested (if schema changed)
- [ ] Browser/mobile behavior checked (if UI changed)
- [ ] Security and privacy impact reviewed

## Data and licensing

- [ ] No third-party content added, or source/licence/attribution is documented
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, database files or user data included

## Screenshots / notes

Add screenshots for UI changes and note any migration or configuration steps.
